name: leadmagic_email_hit
manifest:
# LeadMagic email-finder — declarative provider manifest.
# Spec: LeadMagic/leadmagic-openapi (leadmagic-openapi-3.1.json). Cost: 1 credit.
# Demonstrates the YAML-only provider pattern (no Python). Inactive until
# LEADMAGIC_API_KEY is set in settings/env.
manifest_version: "1"
name: leadmagic_email
display_name: LeadMagic Email Finder
author: OpenGTM
homepage: https://leadmagic.io
tags: [email, enrichment, byok]
capability: email
capabilities: [email]
description: LeadMagic /email-finder — first/last + domain → work email.
default_confidence: 0.8
cost_per_lookup: 0.05
auth:
  type: header
  param: X-API-Key
  env_var: LEADMAGIC_API_KEY
request:
  method: POST
  url: https://api.leadmagic.io/email-finder
  headers:
    Content-Type: application/json
  body:
    first_name: "{{input.first_name}}"
    last_name: "{{input.last_name}}"
    domain: "{{input.domain}}"
    company_name: "{{input.company}}"
  timeout: 20
response:
  mappings:
    email: "$.email"

name: mobile_normalized
manifest:
# LeadMagic mobile-finder — declarative provider manifest.
# Spec: LeadMagic/leadmagic-openapi (POST /mobile-finder; body accepts
# profile_url / work_email / personal_email — "provide at least one"; 200
# response: {message, credits_consumed, mobile_number|null}). Cost: 1 credit
# (0 if not found). Inert until LEADMAGIC_API_KEY is set.
#
# Primary capability is mobile_phone (person DIRECT DIAL, Clay-parity
# "mobile phone" waterfall); also fills the generic phone field for
# back-compat with the capability registry.
manifest_version: "1"
name: leadmagic_mobile
display_name: LeadMagic Mobile Finder
author: OpenGTM
homepage: https://leadmagic.io
tags: [phone, enrichment, byok]
capability: mobile_phone
capabilities: [mobile_phone, phone]
description: LeadMagic /mobile-finder — LinkedIn profile or work email → mobile number.
default_confidence: 0.8
cost_per_lookup: 0.05
auth:
  type: header
  param: X-API-Key
  env_var: LEADMAGIC_API_KEY
request:
  method: POST
  url: https://api.leadmagic.io/mobile-finder
  headers:
    Content-Type: application/json
  body:
    profile_url: "{{input.linkedin_url}}"
    work_email: "{{input.email}}"
  timeout: 20
response:
  mappings:
    mobile_phone: "$.mobile_number"
    phone: "$.mobile_number"

name: prospeo_error_envelope
manifest:
# Prospeo mobile-finder — declarative provider manifest.
# Spec: prospeo.io/api/mobile-finder — POST https://api.prospeo.io/mobile-finder,
# auth header X-KEY, JSON body {"url": "<linkedin profile url>"}. Success
# response: {"error": false, "response": {"raw_format": "+9725236800..",
# "international_format": ..., "national_format": ..., ...}}; errors come as
# {"error": true, "message": "..."} (endpoint + X-KEY + raw_format verified
# against vendor docs; body param `url` per vendor mobile-finder page).
# BYOK: inert until PROSPEO_API_KEY is set (same key as the prospeo email
# provider). Cost approximate — Prospeo bills mobile hits at a premium over
# email credits; refine from your plan's pricing.
manifest_version: "1"
name: prospeo_mobile
display_name: Prospeo Mobile Finder
author: OpenGTM
homepage: https://prospeo.io
tags: [phone, enrichment, byok]
capability: mobile_phone
capabilities: [mobile_phone]
description: Prospeo /mobile-finder — LinkedIn profile URL → verified mobile number.
default_confidence: 0.8
cost_per_lookup: 0.10
auth:
  type: header
  param: X-KEY
  env_var: PROSPEO_API_KEY
request:
  method: POST
  url: https://api.prospeo.io/mobile-finder
  headers:
    Content-Type: application/json
  body:
    url: "{{input.linkedin_url}}"
  timeout: 20
response:
  error_path: error
  error_message_path: message
  mappings:
    mobile_phone: "$.response.raw_format"
